answer.book: A single 1669 controversial work, Johannis vander Waeyen's Pro veritate et genuina Reformatorum sententia against Ludovicus Wolzogius, in three books, preceded by a preface, an addendum and an argument of the work, and followed by errata.

entries.title: Liber primus. Johannis vander Waeyen Pro veritate, & genuina Reformatorum sententia adversus Lud. Wolzogium disceptationis liber primus.
Liber secundus. Johannis vander Waeyen Pro veritate, et genuina Reformatorum sententia, adversus Ludovicum Wolzogium, disceptationis liber secundus.
Liber tertius. Johannis vander Waeyen Pro veritate, & genuina Reformatorum sententia adversus Lud. Wolzogium disceptationis liber tertius.
Errata aliquot typogr. graviora sic corrigat lector, eaque ut & plura alia authoris à prælo absentiæ imputet.
